column1: # Which document is normative for each Stable claim in V1_SCOPE.md.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
# V1_SCOPE.md says what v1.0 claims. The specification index says what status
# each document carries. Nothing connected the two, so the release could -- and
# did -- claim a surface Stable while the only document specifying it said
# "Research Draft. Not normative. Not a basis for an implementation."
# A reader who believes the scope table and a reader who believes the document
# reach opposite conclusions about whether they may implement against it, and
# both are reading the release. That is the defect check-maturity.sh exists to
# make impossible.
# The mapping is written by hand ON PURPOSE. Which document is normative for a
# claim is an editorial judgement, and a script that guessed it from filenames
# would silently guess wrong and then certify its own guess.
# Format: <claim>\t<repo/path/to/spec.md>
# A claim may name more than one document; every one of them must be Stable.
# Lines beginning with # are comments.
